name: Centurion Strike with a polearm stabs the target an additional time (#6905)
contract: Centurion Strike 802738 (Rank 6, DmgClass Melee, SpellFamily 24) reads 'Stab an enemy, dealing $s3%
Weapon Damage plus an additional effect based on your weapon', and its polearm line reads 'Stabs the
target and enemies behind them an additional time'.
The core resolves the polearm effect in two halves: every enemy inside the 5 yd deep, 5 yd wide box
behind the main target is added for the two weapon damage effects (EFFECT_0 NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG and
EFFECT_2 WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE, basePoints 274 at rank 6), and the main target takes the additional
strike. The additional strike used to be folded into the same hit (targetInfo.damage x 2), so the
client reported a single bonk even though the damage was doubled.
The additional strike is now dealt as its own damage event, so a polearm must report two 802738 damage
logs on the main target and one on the enemy behind it. A two-handed sword only triggers the sword
effect 807967 (2 extra auto attacks) and must report exactly one 802738 damage log on the main target
Fixture: guardian level 80 on the default location facing the spawn axis, Jeweled Halberd 30396 in the
main hand, hostiles at distance 2 (front) and 5 (back) so that back sits 3 yd behind front on the same
axis, well inside the polearm box.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the polearm is in the main hand
802738 damage logs on the main target before the polearm cast
802738 damage logs behind the target before the polearm cast
DISCRIMINATING: the main target takes the stab an additional time
the enemy behind takes the additional stab once
802738 damage logs on the main target before the sword control
802738 damage logs behind the target before the sword control
CONTROL: a two-handed sword is in the main hand
Let the 15 s cooldown and the global cooldown expire
Centurion Strike with a two-handed sword
CONTROL: the sword lands a single stab on the main target
CONTROL: the sword reaches nothing behind the main target
